An '''attack''' on the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] began when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy's]] [[First Coruscant Task Force]] jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and surprise-ambushed the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]], causing their forces to scatter between multiple hyperspace jumps of their own. [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] was seriously wounded by shipman [[Tealart]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] traitor, during the initial phase of the battle. The Alliance fleet eventually made their way to the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]] where they were pursued by the Imperials, but managed to turn the tide of the battle in their favor as their enemies jumped out of hyperspace behind them.<ref name="Legacy 42" />
